modules.doc: Typed command registry and palette dispatch.

functions.doc: Register a typed user command in the host registry.
functions.name: create

params.doc: Command spec including title, args, run.
params.name: spec

args: name must be a non-empty string
spec.run must be a function
spec.context, when present, must be a known context name
spec.args must declare valid types
notes: Commands are owned by the plugin generation and dropped on reload/unload.
Re-registering the same name within a generation replaces the previous spec.

functions.doc: Invoke a registered command by name through the host dispatcher.
functions.name: invoke

params.doc: Argument table; validated against the command's arg schema.
params.name: args

returns.doc: True when dispatch succeeded; false on validation/capability/run failure.

args: name must be a registered command
args must be a table or nil
notes: Argument validation, caller capability checks, and dispatch happen host-side.
Built-in commands declare their plugin-invocation capabilities in command.list().

functions.doc: List every registered command.
functions.name: list

modules.name: command

functions.doc: Set the active keymap leader sequence used to expand `<leader>` bindings.
functions.name: set_leader

params.doc: Vim-style key sequence used as leader, e.g. `<Space>` or `,`.
params.name: leader

args: leader must parse as a vim-style key sequence when `<leader>` bindings are installed
notes: The leader is host-global for the active keymap registry.

functions.doc: Bind a key chord to a registered command in a context.
functions.name: set

params.doc: Command name resolved by the host command registry at dispatch time.
params.name: command

args: context must be a non-empty string
key must parse as a vim-style key sequence
command must be a string (resolved at dispatch time)
notes: Plugin keymaps are owned by the calling generation and dropped on reload/unload.
Conflicts are resolved deterministically: built-in > user > plugin (lex by plugin id, then registration order).

functions.doc: Remove a previously-registered keymap owned by the calling plugin generation.
functions.name: del

params.doc: Activation context the keymap was bound under.
params.name: context

args: context must be a string
key must be a string
notes: Plugins can only delete their own bindings; user / built-in rows are unaffected.

functions.doc: List every registered keymap (built-in, user, plugin) including conflict losers.
functions.name: list

returns.doc: Array of keymap summaries with conflict status.

modules.doc: Autocmd group and typed-event registration namespace.

functions.doc: Create or fetch an autocmd group handle. Pass `{ clear = true }` to remove any prior autocmds in the group before returning the handle.
functions.name: group

params.doc: Group name; the same string maps to the same handle for the lifetime of the plugin generation.
params.name: name

returns.doc: Stable group handle to pass into `leviathan.autocmd.create`.

args: name must be a string
opts.clear, when present, must be a boolean
notes: Groups belong to the calling plugin's generation; reload drops them.

functions.doc: Register an autocmd for a single typed event.
functions.name: create

params.doc: Canonical event name, alias, or array of names.
params.name: event

args: event must name a registered host event
opts.callback must be a function
opts.pattern, when present, must be a non-empty string
opts.debounce_ms, when present, must be a non-negative integer
opts.priority, when present, must be an integer
notes: Callbacks are owned by the plugin generation and dropped on reload or unload.
Failing callbacks are disabled after 5 consecutive failures (devtools-visible).

functions.doc: Remove every autocmd registered against a group handle.
functions.name: clear

args: group must be an integer returned by leviathan.autocmd.group
notes: The group handle itself remains valid after clear.

modules.name: autocmd

modules.doc: UI region and plugin screen APIs.

functions.doc: Register an overlay widget the host renders above the active screen.
functions.name: overlay

params.doc: Overlay descriptor (id, widget, dismissible, priority, key_events).
params.name: spec

args: spec.id must be a string
spec.widget must be a LeviathanWidget table
spec.dismissible must be boolean
spec.priority must be a number
spec.key_events must be an array of supported keys when present
notes: Host owns Esc / click-outside dismissal.
Opted-in key events call on_event(id, "key", value) before keymaps or screen input.

functions.doc: Compatibility callable alias for `leviathan.ui.dialog.open`; opens a repository-owned toolbar dialog on the active repository screen.
functions.name: dialog

params.doc: Repository toolbar dialog descriptor (id, text, optional controls, buttons).
params.name: spec

args: spec.id must be a string
spec.text must be a string
spec.buttons must contain one or more button specs
button.style must be red, green, blue, or white
button.text must be a string
button.on_click must be a function
button.keys must be an array of supported keys when present
notes: Requires an active repository screen.
Button clicks call the matching button function.
Configured keys call the same button function as a click.
Escape follows dialog data: a button key binding handles it first, otherwise dismissible dialogs close.
The dialog is rendered in the repository toolbar band.

functions.doc: Open a repository-owned toolbar dialog on the active repository screen; button keys, including Escape, are data-driven.
functions.name: dialog.open

params.doc: Repository toolbar dialog descriptor (id, text, optional controls, buttons).
params.name: spec

args: spec.id must be a string
spec.text must be a string
spec.buttons must contain one or more button specs
button.style must be red, green, blue, or white
button.text must be a string
button.on_click must be a function
button.keys must be an array of supported keys when present
notes: Requires an active repository screen.
Button clicks call the matching button function.
Configured keys call the same button function as a click.
Escape follows dialog data: a button key binding handles it first, otherwise dismissible dialogs close.
The dialog is rendered in the repository toolbar band.

functions.doc: Focus a text input control in the active repository toolbar dialog.
functions.name: dialog.focus_control

returns.doc: True on success, nil on failure.

args: dialog_id must be a string
control_id must be a string
notes: No-ops when the active toolbar dialog or control does not match.
returns: true plus nil error, or nil plus error string

functions.doc: Press a button in the active repository toolbar dialog.
functions.name: dialog.press_button

returns.doc: True on success, nil on failure.

args: dialog_id must be a string
button_id must be a string
notes: Routes through the same dialog dispatcher as a click.
Disabled buttons are ignored by the host dialog dispatcher.
returns: true plus nil error, or nil plus error string

can_add: new functions, types, optional fields, widgets, capabilities, events, and extension points in host 1.x
new enum values only when older plugins can ignore them
can_remove: nothing from public UI v1 during host 1.x
experimental entries only after their descriptor marks the replacement promise
semver_policy.descriptor_versioning: Descriptor schema changes increment descriptor_version; plugin api major changes reset the stable descriptor contract.
requires_deprecation: renaming public functions, fields, widgets, capabilities, events, or extension points
tightening validation for an accepted public v1 shape

stability_policy.migration_promise: UI v1 descriptors keep source-compatible additions within host 1.x; removals require a later major API.
